151.1:
I was smaller than my brothers,
And the youngest of my father’s sons,
So he made me shepherd of his flock
And ruler over his little goats.
151.2:
My hands fashioned a reed pipe,
And my fingers a lyre;
And so I gave esteem to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
I said in my heart:
151.3:
“The mountains cannot witness to Him,
Nor can the hills proclaim -
Lift up my words, you trees,
And my compositions, you sheep.
151.4:
For who can announce, and who can declare,
And who can recount my deeds?”
The Aḏon of all has seen,
The Elohim of all has heard,
And He has paid attention.
151.5:
He sent His naḇi to anoint me,
Shemu’ĕl to raise me up.
My brothers went out to meet him,
Handsome of figure, handsome in appearance.
151.6:
Although they were tall of stature
And handsome because of their hair,
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim did not choose them.
151.7:
But he sent and fetched me from behind the flock
And anointed me with the oil.
And He made me prince of His people
And ruler over the sons of His Covenant.

152.1:
O Elohim, O Elohim, come to my aid;
Help me, save me, and deliver my being from the slayer.
152.2:
Shall I go down to She’ol by the mouth of the lion?
Shall the wolf be the end of me?
152.3:
Was it not enough for those who lay in wait for my father’s flock,
And tore a sheep of my father’s flock.
Must they also wish the destruction of my own being?
152.4:
Have pity, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and save Your kind one from destruction,
So that he may rehearse Your esteem for all of his days,
And may praise Your great Name,
152.5:
When You have delivered him from the hands of the destroying lion and of the ravenous wolf,
And when You have delivered my captivity from the hands of the wild beasts.
152.6:
Quickly, Aḏonai, send from Yourself a deliverer,
And draw me out of the gaping pit which imprisons me in its depths.

153.1:
Praise 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all you nations;
Esteem Him, and baraḵ His Name.
153.2:
He has rescued the being of His chosen from the hands of death,
And delivered His kind one from destruction.
153.3:
He has delivered me from the nets of She’ol,
And my being from the pit that cannot be fathomed.
153.4:
Before my deliverance could go forth from Him,
I was very nearly torn in two pieces by two wild beasts;
153.5:
But He sent His messenger, and closed up for me the gaping mouths,
And rescued my life from destruction.
153.6:
My being shall esteem Him and exalt Him,
Because of all His kindnesses which He has done to me,
And shall continue to do to me.

154.1:
Give esteem to Elohim with a loud voice,
And proclaim His esteem in the assembly of many.
154.2:
Exalt His praise among the multitude of the upright,
And speak of His esteem with the righteous.
154.3:
Join your beings to the good and to the perfect,
To esteem the Most High Elohim.
154.4:
Gather yourselves together to make known His strength,
And do not be slow in showing forth His deliverance,
His strength, and His esteem to all who are young.
154.5:
Wisdom has been given that the esteem of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 may be known,
And it has been made known to men to tell of His works:
154.6:
To make known to children His strength,
And to cause those who lack understanding to understand His esteem,
154.7:
Who are far from His entrances and distant from
His gates;
154.8:
For the Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ is exalted,
And His esteem is upon all His works.
154.9:
He takes pleasure in a man who esteems the Most High,
As in one who offers fine flour.
154.10:
And as in one who offers male goats and calves,
And as in one who makes the altar fat with a multitude of burnt offerings,
And as the smell of incense from the hands of the righteous.
154.11:
His voice shall be heard from Your upright gates,
And admonition from the voice of the upright.
154.12:
In their eating and their drinking, when they share together,
They shall be satisfied in truth.
154.13:
Their mind dwells on the Torah of the Most High Elohim,
And their words are to make known His strength.
154.14:
How far from the wicked are the words of Him,
And from all transgressors to know Him!
154.15:
See; the eye of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shows favor to the good!
He increases favor to those who esteem Him,
And He delivers their being from the time of evil.
154.17:
That He may prolong His dwelling in Tsiyon,
And may adorn our age in Yerushalayim.

155.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I have cried to You;
Hear me.
155.2:
I have lifted up my hands to Your qodesh dwelling place;
Incline Your ear to me.
155.3:
Grant me my request;
Do not withhold my prayer from me.
155.4:
Build up my being, and do not destroy it,
And do not lay it bare before the wicked.
155.5: Those who reward wickedness turn You away from me, O Judge of truth.
155.6:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do not judge me according to my sins,
Because no flesh is innocent before You.
155.7:
Make Your Torah plain to me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
And teach me Your Right-Rulings.
155.8:
Many shall hear of Your works,
And the nations shall praise Your esteem.
155.9:
Remember me, and do not forget me;
And do not lead me into that which is too difficult for me.
155.10:
Cause the sins of my youth to pass from me,
And remember my discipline against me no longer.
155.11:
Cleanse me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, from the evil leprosy,
And do not let it come against me any longer.
155.12:
Dry up its roots from within me,
And do not let its leaves sprout within me.
155.13:
You are great, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄;
Therefore, my request shall be fulfilled in You.
155.14:
To whom do I complain that He may give to me?
What help can be found in the strength of men?
155.16:
I slumbered and slept;
I dreamed and was helped, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sustained me.
155.17:
They grieved my heart;
I return thanks because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 delivered me.
155.18:
Now I rejoice in their shame;
I have waited on You, and I am not ashamed.
155.19:
May You be given honor forever,
Even forever and ever.
155.20:
Deliver Yisra’ĕl, Your elect,
And those of the house of Ya’aqoḇ, Your proven one.

156.1:
A worm does not thank You,
Nor does a maggot recount Your kindness.
156.2:
Only the living thank You,
All those whose feet stumble thank You,
When You make Your kindness known to them,
And cause them to understand Your righteousness;
156.3:
For the being of all the living is in Your hand,
And You have given breath to all flesh.
156.4:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do to us according to Your goodness,
According to the greatness of Your compassion,
And according to the greatness of Your righteous deeds.
156.5:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 listens to the voice of all who love His Name,
And He does not permit His kindness to depart from them.
156.6:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, who does righteous deeds,
Who crowns His qodeshim with kindness and favors.
156.7:
My being shouts to praise Your Name,
To praise Your compassion with joy,
To announce Your trustworthiness;
For there is no limit to Your praises.
156.8:
I belonged to death because of my sins,
And my wickednesses had sold me to She’ol;
156.9:
But You saved me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
According to the greatness of Your compassion,
And according to the greatness of Your righteous deeds.
156.10:
I have, indeed, loved Your Name,
And have taken refuge in Your shadow.
156.11:
My heart is strengthened when I remember Your power,
And I rely on Your compassion.
156.12:
Forgive my sins, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
And cleanse me of my wickedness.
156.13:
Grant me a spirit of faithfulness and knowledge;
Let me not be ashamed in ruin.
156.14:
Do not allow the wicked one or an unclean spirit to overtake me,
And do not allow affliction or evil inclination to possess my bones;
156.15:
For You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, are my praise,
And I wait on You every day.
156.16:
My brothers rejoice with me,
And the house of my father is awed by Your favor.
156.17: I shall always rejoice in You.

157.2:
Your expectancy is great, O Tsiyon;
Peace and your awaited deliverance shall come.
157.3:
Generation after generation shall dwell in you,
And generations of the righteous shall be your ornament.
157.4:
They who long for the day of your deliverance
Shall rejoice in the greatness of your esteem.
157.5:
They shall be nursed on the fullness of your esteem,
And in your lovely streets they shall make tinkling sounds.
157.6:
You shall remember the righteous deeds of your neḇi’im,
And shall esteem yourself in the deeds of your righteous ones.
157.7:
Cleanse violence from your midst;
May lying and wickedness be cut off from you.
157.8:
Your sons shall rejoice within you,
And your loved ones shall be joined to you.
How much have they waited on your deliverance?
157.9: How much have your perfect ones mourned for you?
157.10:
Your expectancy, O Tsiyon, shall not perish,
And your expectation shall not be forgotten.
157.11:
Is there a righteous man who has perished?
Is there a man who has escaped his wickedness?
157.12:
Man is tried according to his way,
Each is repaid according to his deeds.
157.13:
Your oppressors shall be cut off from around you, O Tsiyon,
And all who hate you shall be dispersed.
157.14:
Your praise is pleasing, O Tsiyon;
It rises up in all the world.
157.15:
I remember you many times for a beraḵah,
And I baraḵ you with all My heart.
157.16:
You shall attain to everlasting righteousness,
And shall receive bireḵoth from the noble.
157.17:
Take the vision which speaks of you,
And the dreams of the neḇi’im requested for you.
157.18:
Be exalted and increase, O Tsiyon,
And praise the Most High, your Redeemer!
May my being rejoice in Your esteem!

158.1: In the midst of the congregation they shall praise the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
158.2:
For He has come to judge every action,
To remove the wicked from the earth,
So that the children of wickedness shall not be found.
158.3:
The shamayim shall give their dew,
And there shall be no drought within their boundaries.
158.4:
The earth shall give its fruit in its time,
And its produce shall not fail.
158.5:
The fruit trees shall give of the fruit of its vineyards,
And the ground shall not deprive of its produce.
158.6: The poor shall eat, and those who revere Elohim shall be filled.

159.1:
The shamayim and earth shall give praise together.
Let all the stars of the evening twilight give praise!
159.2:
Rejoice, Yahuḏah; rejoice!
Rejoice, rejoice and be glad with gladness!
159.3:
Celebrate your Feasts, and pay your vows;
For there is no wickedness in your midst.
159.4: Raise your hand, and fortify your right hand!
159.5:
Behold, the enemy shall perish,
And all the workers of wickedness shall be dispersed;
159.6:
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, are forever,
And Your esteem shall be forever and ever.
Hallelu-Yah!

160.1:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is great and qodesh,
The most qodesh for generation after generation.
160.2:
Excellency goes before Him,
And abundance of many waters comes after Him.
160.3:
Kindness and truth surround His face;
Truth, right-ruling, and righteousness are the pedestal of His throne.
160.4:
He divides light from the unknown,
And He establishes the dawn by the knowledge of His heart.
160.5:
All His messengers sang when they saw it;
For He showed them that which they had not known.
160.6:
He crowns the mountains with fruit,
With good food for all the living.
160.7:
May the Aḏon of the earth be baruḵ, along with His power;
For He establishes the world by His wisdom.
160.8:
He stretched out the shamayim by His understanding,
And brought forth wind from His stores.
160.9:
He made lightnings for the rain,
And raised mist from the end of the earth.
